daily_loss_limit.calculation_basis: balance recorded at 00:00 CE(S)T minus 3% of Initial Simulated Capital; first day uses Initial Simulated Capital

max_loss_limit.calculation_basis: end-of-day trailing limit: highest account balance achieved at 00:00 CE(S)T of any preceding trading day, or Initial Simulated Capital if higher, minus 10% of Initial Simulated Capital; limit can increase but not decrease
